title: Win It and Go
format: 4v4 plus two keepers, then a 3v2 counter
area: 50m x 36m, a goal at each end (7m wide), halfway line marked with cones
kit: Red and Blue bibs, keepers in a third colour, plenty of balls in each goal
start: Blue start with the ball on the halfway line and attack the right hand goal

steps.say: Blue build an attack. Red hold a tight shape and R5 and R6 stay high and wide.
steps.vo: Blue build an attack towards the right hand goal. Red stay tight and compact, and R5 and R6 stay high and wide, ready to break.

steps.say: Blue work it inside to B4 and Red shuffle across to stay compact.
steps.vo: Blue play inside to B4. Red shuffle across together and keep the gaps small.

steps.say: TRIGGER: the shot. R5 and R6 sprint forward as it is struck. Keeper saves.
steps.vo: B4 shoots. The shot is the trigger. R5 and R6 sprint forward before the keeper even has the ball.

steps.say: Keeper throws long to R5 within two seconds. Blue turn and race back.
steps.vo: The keeper gets it away quickly, to R5, in about two seconds. Blue are caught high up the pitch and have to turn and race back.

steps.say: 3v2. R5 drives forward, R6 runs wide, R4 arrives down the middle.
steps.vo: Now it is three against two. R5 drives forward with the ball, R6 runs wide, and R4 arrives through the middle. B5 and B6 are outnumbered.

steps.say: R5 draws B5, then plays into R4 in the middle.
steps.vo: R5 draws B5 towards him, and then plays into R4 in the middle. That pass takes a defender out of the game.

steps.say: R4 slides it into the path of R6, running in behind.
steps.vo: R4 slides it into the path of R6, who has kept running wide and in behind the defence.

steps.say: R6 shoots first time. Whole counter takes under ten seconds.
steps.vo: R6 finishes first time. The whole counter attack takes under ten seconds from the save.

setup: Blue 4 attackers (B1 to B4) against Red 4 defenders (R1 to R4) and a Red keeper at the right hand goal.
Red outlet players R5 and R6 wait on the halfway line either side of the area.
Blue recovery defenders B5 and B6 wait near the left hand goal with a Blue keeper.
rules: Blue have eight touches or one minute to shoot.
Red can only counter once they have won the ball or the keeper has made a save.
A goal for Red inside ten seconds of winning the ball counts double.
Offside applies in the right hand half only.
restart: Ball out of play or a goal: Blue restart from halfway with a new ball.
If Blue score, the keeper restarts to Red outlet players as before.
points: Go early: the first pass after the regain is forward and positive.
Run in three lanes: one wide left, one wide right, one through the middle.
The player in the middle arrives late so the defenders cannot mark them early.
Take one touch to get the ball out of your feet, then move it.
Defenders: slow the ball down, never dive in, and get goal side.
progress: Make it 5v4 on the break, then 4v4.
Add a six second limit to score from the regain.
Play the full 9v9 or 11v11 game and award bonus points for goals from regains.
